name: Grok Imagine 2.0
description: xAI's image model. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. Model id from fal's model index on 2026-09-11; the adapter is written from the provider's schema and has not run against the live API yet. Also on OpenRouter. Also on Comfy Router. Also on Oxen.ai.

fal.note: At most three images go in (crop plus two references). The output size is Resolution, not the crop; aspect_ratio stays auto, which keeps the crop's shape. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area".

openrouter.note: Runs on OpenRouter (one key for many models); the adapter has run against the live API with GPT Image 2.5, this model not yet. The pictures go inline in the request to OpenRouter, which passes them to xAI. Instruction edit of the crop plus the reference layers, no mask input: the stitch keeps the selection. For area-directed edits set Fill to green and Original on, and say "fill the green area". An edit sends no aspect, so the host keeps the crop's shape as its own edit endpoint does (not verified); an answer of another shape is centre-cropped. At most three pictures go in (the crop plus two). Resolution auto takes the smallest tier that covers the crop.

comfyrouter.note: Runs on Comfy Router (api.comfy.org) with the Comfy Cloud key, billed in Comfy credits, no paid plan needed; not run against the live API yet. Only the prompt goes to Comfy, which passes it to xAI; the answer comes back through Comfy's storage. The Router's schema for this model takes no input picture, so this variant makes images from the prompt alone: it works in "Generate new", not in Generate. The dialog's aspect is sent as the closest of xAI's presets; Resolution auto takes the smallest tier that covers the asked size.

oxen.note: Runs on Oxen.ai (one key for many models); not run against the live API yet (written from Oxen's docs and model list, 2026-09-26). The pictures go inline (data URLs, which Oxen's docs allow but do not recommend for production) in the request to Oxen.ai, which runs the model or passes it on; Oxen keeps every generated image in your Oxen account, and its terms could not be read, so how long it keeps what you send is not stated. One picture only: the edit takes the crop and nothing else, so turn Original off and hide the reference layers. Instruction edit, no mask: the stitch keeps the selection. An answer of another shape is centre-cropped. "Generate new" runs Oxen's text model (xai-grok-imagine-image) at 1k or 2k. Oxen names no Grok Imagine version. List price $0.022 an edit, $0.02 a new image (2026-09-26).
